title: Large staged group photo in auditorium with projected event backdrop
objects_and_counts: A large group of people standing on the stage in front of the projection screen; at least 50 individual people are visibly distinguishable in the photographed scene (exact total cannot be determined because of overlap and partial occlusion).
One grand piano located on the right side of the stage (visible and complete).
Two floor stage monitors (black) visible at the front edge of the stage (one left-of-center, one right-of-center).
At least two microphone stands positioned near the front-center of the stage (one with a microphone visible).
A seated ensemble of musicians holding wooden, vertical-pipe or xylophone-like instruments on the far right of the stage; at least eight seated musicians are visible there.
A group of percussion or traditional instruments and musicians on the far left of the stage; at least four people and multiple instruments are visible in that left stage area.
A large projection screen or backdrop covering the rear of the stage with logos and event text displayed across it.
Two people near the right-front area operating or standing by the microphone area and music stands (distinct from the seated ensemble).
visible_text: Global Inclusive Leadership Program 2019 STEM+ Leadership Week
spatial_relations: A large projection backdrop fills the entire rear of the stage; the group of standing people is arranged across the central portion of the stage in front of that backdrop.
The grand piano sits to the right-rear of the standing group (stage right from the viewer's perspective), with seated musicians holding wooden instruments further right of the piano.
Percussion instruments and additional musicians occupy the far left-rear area of the stage behind and to the left of the standing group.
Two black floor monitors are positioned on the front edge of the stage, one near the left-front and one near the right-front relative to the viewer, in front of the standing performers.
Microphone stands are near the center-front of the standing group, between the front edge of the stage and the backdrop group.
colours_and_materials: The stage floor is wood-coloured, appearing as varnished light-to-medium brown hardwood.
The backdrop/projection shows warm, multicoloured bokeh effects with dominant gold, green and pink tones.
The grand piano and stage monitors are black and have a matte-to-semi-gloss finish.
Many participants wear dark-coloured (navy or black) shirts and some wear white tops; seated musicians on the right wear blue uniforms or skirts.
uncertainties: Exact count of people is uncertain due to overlap and partial occlusion; the quoted 'at least 50' is a visible minimum not a precise total.
Several small logos and lines of text on the backdrop are not legible at this resolution; only the larger headings and a few words could be transcribed reliably.
The transcription 'SINCE 1376' is taken from the visible characters on the image; the middle digit(s) are small and could be misread (commonly '1876' on similar logos), so this text is uncertain.
The single visible printed fragment '7th' near the lower-right of the backdrop is partial and the rest of that line (e.g., month or context) is not legible.
The exact identity or type of the wooden instruments held by the seated musicians (right side) is not fully determinable from the image; they are described by visible appearance only.
No room name or number is visible anywhere in the image, so the location is unknown from the image.
